markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (92%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Reliability flag is raised [F6] and Benign remains in the conformal set.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 92%, Benign 8% | Clear lead, Invasive 0% |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (90%) | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.22 / 22nd percentile | Flagged; input suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Different top class | Not independently confirmed |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Normal | Mostly supportive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Validated
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 1, 6, 9) · ↓ invasive · Strongest concept term; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 1, 5, 10) · context · Descriptive only; spot check 8/20 · Weak
- **Few neoplastic nuclei** (regions 0, 4, 11) · ↓ invasive · 6% neoplastic, 37th percentile; sampled regions only · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions lowers the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier; normal lobules is Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Low image reliability (0.22) distorts the Normal probability.
- The slide holds Benign change; MUSK picks a different top class.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 6, 9:** Verify two-layered lobular epithelium yourself; concept spot check failed.
2. **Region 10:** Look for atypical cells within ducts; it tops duct-confined and pleomorphism concepts.
3. **Region 11:** Review the 7 nuclei labelled neoplastic; other sampled regions had none.
